Title: Final QA audit and closure
Purpose: Perform the strict final QA inspection, prove the bundle contents are honest and complete, and only then package the final ZIP for delivery.
Deliverables: Final QA memo with honest execution boundaries
ReviewQuestions: Does the bundle state clearly what was validated here versus what still requires execution in a dotnet-capable environment?
Does the ZIP actually contain the process template folders the user expected?
Is every skipped or deferred item explicit rather than implied away?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create one last corrective subbundle and repeat the final QA audit. Delivery is blocked until the closure memo is honest and complete.
